Layout change only: src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.{c,h} sit in src/ beside monocypher.{c,h}. The same copy, with the
same sha256 values, is vendored by EchoConstruct (third_party/monocypher, c1d5805b7). nevr_core compiles both files
(src/core/maps.cmake) for minisign verification of the custom-map channel manifest (src/core/minisign_verify.cpp:
Ed25519 with SHA-512 over a BLAKE2b-512 prehash; docs/adr/0047).
